rows.abstract: The bill proposes the deduction of the cost of devolved functions from the internal revenue allotment (IRA) before the IRA is divided among the local government units (LGUs).  It also seeks the direct release of the amount corresponding to the amount of devolved functions to the LGUs concerned.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-04-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL ACCREDITING AGENCY FOR TEACHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS (NAATEI)
rows.title_short: \"Natiolnal Accrediting Agency for Teacher Education Institutions Act\"
rows.abstract: Establishes the National Accrediting Agency for Teacher Education Institutions that shall be tasked to address specific problems and issues on basic education, upgrade the level of teaching competencies, institute policy reforms, develop critical skills needed specially by science and math teachers and encourage their professional growth and advancement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2008-04-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING MOVIE, TELEVISION, AND RADIO PRODUCERS, INCLUDING PROMOTION AND ADVERTISING AGENCIES, AND OTHER LIKE ENTITIES, EMPLOYING UNEMANCIPATED MINORS TO DEPOSIT THEIR TALENT FEES OR INCOME IN A TRUST FUND, IMPOSING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes to set up a trust fund where one-half of a child-actor's talent fee, income,  or earnings are kept for safekeeping while earning interest.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-04-28

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF FULLY-EQUIPPED SCIENCE LABORATORIES IN EVERY PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOL AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Science Laboratory for Basic Education Act\"
rows.abstract: Aims to provide venue and materials for students' direct and hands-on experiences in science and technology learning.  Also makes provision for the operation, repair, maintenance and upgrading of acquired laboratory equipment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-04-28

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MINIMUM CONTENTS OF A COMPREHENSIVE REPORT OF ELECTIONS TO THE PRESIDENT AND TO CONGRESS BY THE COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS
rows.title_short: \"Comprehensive COMELEC Report Act\"
rows.abstract: Directs the COMELEC to include in its report to the President and to Congress to a narrative assessment and basic electoral data - on voters; on precincts; on the number of ballots, election returns, ballot boxes and all other accountable forms; on candidates; on election protests, violence and other election violations and offenses; and other data deemed important.

rows.title_short: \"Children's Media Protection Act\"

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-04-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 24(c) AND 35 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997\" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the personal exemption of individual taxpayers as follows: a) single - from P20,000 to P30,000; b) head of the family - from P25,000 to P50,000; and c) married individual - from P32,000 to P50,000. It also increase the additional exemption for dependents from P8,000 to P12,000 for each dependent not exceeding four.

rows.abstract: Creates the National Food Security Council that shall be tasked to establish ideal levels of inventory annually for key food products, and come up with rules and regulations governing the importation of key food products in the context of the annual ideal inventory level report.
